# atom ctrl

> atom ctrl builds world thinking machines that learn how the world changes, predict outcomes, and help robots act across longer tasks.

atom ctrl is a research lab focused on world models, action prediction, robot control, and longer-horizon tasks.

## Pages

- [Home](https://atomctrl.com/): The company direction and core ideas.
- [Research](https://atomctrl.com/research): Research notes and technical work.
- [Team](https://atomctrl.com/team): The people behind atom ctrl.
- [FAQ](https://atomctrl.com/faq/what-is-atom-ctrl-and-what-is-it-building): Common questions about the company and its work.

## Research

- [Project Monarch](https://atomctrl.com/research/monarch): An earlier model and research direction.
- [Interaction Systems](https://atomctrl.com/research/interaction-systems): Research on real-time voice interaction.
- [Gödel 1.6](https://atomctrl.com/research/godel-model): A hybrid local and cloud model architecture.
- [Scaling Synthetic Data](https://atomctrl.com/research/scaling-synthetic-data): Research on cleaner training data for compact models.

## Scope

atom ctrl is one company and research lab. Its work is in progress. The site describes research, prototypes, and technical ideas. It does not claim to be a finished robotics product.

- [Full machine-readable overview](https://atomctrl.com/llms-full.txt)
